structured_output.summary: Phase 27 delivers the directional-profile addition rigorously. The overlay is additive and mechanically proven: the 12-node ancestor closure is derived, not asserted; every historical graph node/root survives byte-identically against baseline 578f2e6; exactly five optional projections give lossless, typed-wins behaviour; profiles.rs repoints only the two request-schema arguments. A real pinned-Zod oracle (906 cases, 231 accepted) is replayed from Rust, with all three modes for the two new roots. All 107 recorded checks exit 0 on source 93d22ec in one 09:53–10:11 window, including both compilers, the executed example, the patched lockfile and a current-source bounded read-only receipt. Docs separate offline, live and release honestly. Four low/medium findings remain open, chiefly an operation-mapping citation that credits a list-only test to create/update/get. Total 45/50 — one point under the 46 phase bar.

findings.description: The create (633), get (689) and update (785) rows cite crates/scm-sdk/tests/management_contracts.rs::profile_wire_defaults_and_empty_terminal_pages_follow_request_options as contract evidence, but that test (management_contracts.rs:1985-2044) calls only list_for_token, list and list_all; it never invokes create, update or get. The over-attribution propagates into contracts/native-operations.json, contracts/native-exports.json and contracts/qualification.json, and tools/test_typescript035_profiles.py:31-32 actively requires it by iterating all four WIRE_TESTS for create/update. This was flagged in the attempt-05 wire chunk review and is unchanged in the reviewed source.
findings.required_fix: Bind profile_wire_defaults_and_empty_terminal_pages_follow_request_options only to the listForToken/list/listAll rows, drop it from create/update/get, regenerate native-operations.json, native-exports.json and qualification.json, and narrow tools/test_typescript035_profiles.py to the tests each operation actually exercises.

findings.description: The replay loop derives both the registry name form (versioned prefix vs plain) and the mode set from the string heuristic name.starts_with("ContentType") at lines 49 and 56. The expected-root assertion at line 48 keeps it fail-closed today, but the versioned/unversioned namespace split is inferred rather than declared, so a future versioned root whose name begins with ContentType would be looked up unprefixed.
findings.required_fix: Replace the prefix test with an explicit table mapping each of the eight roots to its registry name and mode list.

findings.description: The baseline-derived generator digest check hardcodes the 40-character baseline commit '578f2e631cbf649c073f9f8940a9ce60216c58ed' instead of reusing the existing shared constant (tools/test_typescript035_implementation.py:13 BASELINE), and calls subprocess.check_output without a timeout, unlike tools/test_schema_oracle.py. A baseline move must be edited in two places.
findings.required_fix: Import the baseline commit from one shared constant and pass an explicit timeout to the git subprocess call.

findings.description: The oracle imports the pinned upstream module in-process (await import(pathToFileURL(model).href)) without the host-API denial stubs the sibling frozen oracle installs before executing vendor schemas (tools/verify-gateway-specimens.mts). Risk is low because the file is SHA-256 and Git-blob pinned and verified before copying (line 19) and imports only 'zod' (contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0/src/models/mgmt-security-profile.ts:1), but that single-import property rests on the byte pin alone rather than a mechanical assertion.
findings.required_fix: Install the same network/host-API denial stubs before the dynamic import, or assert in verify_typescript035_source.py that the pinned model file's import statements resolve only to 'zod'.

findings.description: The test_*.py glob expansion appends commands without the `if command not in commands` dedupe applied on line 337, so commands_for(27) contains five duplicated unittest invocations. The receipt confirms double execution of byte-identical commands: test_management_consumers.py (checks at lines 370 and 900), test_management_fixtures.py, test_red_team_management.py, test_management_phases.py and test_review_phase.py all run twice, costing runtime without added coverage.
findings.required_fix: Apply the same duplicate check to glob-expanded unittest commands in commands_for(27).
